whyIntelligence.title: Four verbs. One platform.
whyIntelligence.description: Tracking tells you where things are. Asset Master tells you everything else: who had it, what happened to it, and whether you can prove it.

tracking.assetMaster: Asset Master automatically captures every scan, transfer, and checkout, keeping the master record synchronized in real time. You always know current location and active custody.
tracking.spreadsheet: A spreadsheet row that goes stale the moment someone forgets to update it.

inspection.assetMaster: Execute digital checklists on mobile, attach geotagged photo proof, and automatically log pass/fail defect status directly from the field.
inspection.spreadsheet: Paper forms, emailed photos, and inspection logs living in someone's inbox.

audit.assetMaster: Instantly compile complete lifecycle history, custody handover signatures, and tamper-proof compliance logs for internal and external auditors.
audit.spreadsheet: Weeks of manual reconciliation across files, folders, and departments.

compliance.assetMaster: Continuously monitor warranty expirations and inspection schedules, automatically flagging overdue items and generating audit-ready reports.
compliance.spreadsheet: Reactive scrambling when regulators, insurers, or executives ask for proof.
